antes.ficci-65: ¿Cómo escribir una historia que se desprende de la vida? Es decir, que queda colgando, como un pedazo de piel, un soporte fotosensible que lleva registrada en sus pliegues la luz.

valor: Mario wakes up with no memory in eastern Mexico City. Adrift alongside Lázaro, he learns to inhabit other people’s bodies through cracks in the earth. A hypnotic journey where the territory pierces the skin and the landscape warps to the rhythm of memories.

antes.ficci-65: How do you write a story that detaches from life? One that hangs loose, like a piece of skin—a photosensitive surface with light recorded in its folds.
antes.mamut-2026: Mario wakes up with no memory of his past life. His encounter with Lazare marks the beginning of a spatio-corporeal drift, from the eastern suburbs of Mexico City to the surrounding underground cavities, where bodies and landscapes crack in the same motion.
